scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,api -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @lightning/web" "npm run dev -w @lightning/api"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @lightning/core && npm run build -w @lightning/api && npm run build -w @lightning/web
scripts.start: concurrently -n web,api "npm run start -w @lightning/web" "npm run start -w @lightning/api"
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @lightning/core && npm run typecheck -w @lightning/api && npm run typecheck -w @lightning/web
